BrightGrid Residential Billing Policy, Section 9:
9.1 Late Payment Fee Waiver: A one-time $15 late fee is waived automatically if the account has had no late payments in the trailing 12 months and the balance is paid within 5 days of the due date.
9.2 Billing Anomaly Review: Triggered automatically when a monthly charge exceeds the account's trailing-3-month average by more than 50%.
9.3 Weather Credit: A flat $20 credit applies to any billing cycle that includes 3 or more days of a declared regional heat emergency, applied automatically without customer request.
9.4 Loyalty Discount: Available only to customers who have opted into paperless billing for 36 consecutive months; not evaluated automatically.

Account #55210-B. July bill: $267. Trailing 3-month average (Apr-Jun): $150. Payment due June 30, actually paid July 3 (3 days late). No late payments on this account in the last 4 years. A regional heat emergency was declared for 5 days in July (July 10-14) per city records.
